details:
To make clear, these worlds can be used by anyone but a Vrchat plus user must unlock them to be used for your guest even without vrchat plus users can join.

The VIP Vrchat plus worlds are mostly meant for large groups while be heavily optimized to match the occasion, for business meetings to streamers wanting to bring a large group into a world fully knowingly that it will support the group size and match their ideals without the worry of obstructions maybe ads or copyright music and inappropriate content while being aesthetically pleasing to match your party needs.

The idea of the VIP worlds is to know "100% certain" that they can hold your guest count and match the needs of the party and be appropriate.

VIP worlds could also be professionally made worlds that won't disappoint your quest.

To a classic ballroom to penthouse rooftop sweets and maybe the classic office meeting room.

Someone wanting to please a party shouldn't have to second guess if the world will fulfill the needs of their party or even business they are trying to appeal to.

I have seen vrchat streamers scramble in a desperate attempt of finding a world that can host their large group without the fear of crashing a member or copyright music with the VIP worlds, this what I want to see be avoided. 

The dream would be to have more worlds like "VirtualFurence Furry Convention Hotel Estrel Berlin" one of the most professional looking worlds in the game having more of these would be ideal to show off vrchat to the outside world especially to any possible investors.

Thank you for reading, I know this is a big project idea, but I think it would be worth it.
title: "VIP worlds" for Vrchat plus users to unlock for guest or use in "professional events"
